name: CQMScoreRange
title: CQM Score Range
description: The range of component measure scores used to normalize the component score to a value between 0 and 1 before it is combined into a component-based composite score.
purpose: When computing weighted composite measures that include ratio or continuous variable components, the component scores are not on a common scale, so the range used to normalize each component score must be specified.

element.definition: The range of component measure scores used to normalize the component score to a value between 0 and 1 before it is combined into a component-based composite score. The normalized score is (score - low) / (high - low), limited to the interval [0, 1].
element.comment: If the score range of a component is not specified, a range of 0 to 1 is assumed (i.e. the component score is used as is). The score range is applied before the improvement notation of the component is taken into account. A score range is required for ratio and continuous variable components of component-based composites, since the scores of those components are not, in general, between 0 and 1.

constraint.human: A score range must specify both a low and a high value, and the high value must be greater than the low value
constraint.expression: value.low.value.exists() and value.high.value.exists() and value.high.value > value.low.value

element.short: The low and high scores used to normalize the component score
element.definition: The low and high component measure scores used to normalize the component score. The units of the range, if specified, are the scoring units of the component measure.
